description.full:
Transform your Android device into a complete Flutter development environment.

Features:
- One-tap Flutter SDK installation
- Full Flutter/Dart command support
- Firebase tools integration
- Termux-powered local execution
- Real-time debugging and testing

Prerequisites:
• Termux (F-Droid)
• Termux:API (F-Droid) - Required for command execution
• Acode X Terminal Plugin (Recommended)
